Inherited from Prakrit 𑀟𑁄𑀮𑀸 (ḍolā) + Middle Indo-Aryan -𑀇𑀓𑀸- (-ikā-), from Sanskrit दोला (dolā). By surface analysis, डोला (ḍolā) + ई (ī).

ety.text: From रण (raṇ, “battle, war”) + छोड़ना (choṛnā, “to abandon”). The name came from the legend of Jarasandha's defeat.

s.g: raj kachori: a spicy dish of Delhi
